import pathlib
path=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545471/attempts/cb5c46cb9eb34b0fb84b0c3660206bd3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-59efedd2.py')
path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Identify the large outlined rectangle from the rare non-background marks.
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != color]
    # The frame is the bounding box of the colored structure; fill single/multiple gaps
    # along its four edges with the marker color 2.
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        if grid[r0][c] == color: out[r0][c] = 2
        if grid[r1][c] == color: out[r1][c] = 2
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        if grid[r][c0] == color: out[r][c0] = 2
        if grid[r][c1] == color: out[r][c1] = 2
    return out
'''
path.write_text(source)
# run transform on test, output
